parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the toilet is a flat, hinged cover made of plastic, designed to close over the seat and bowl.
parts.Functional_description: It serves to cover the toilet bowl when not in use, providing hygiene and aesthetic purposes.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate upward and downward around a hinge located at the back of the seat.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the toilet is the main ceramic structure that includes the bowl and tank.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the user’s weight, holds water, and connects to the plumbing system for flushing and waste removal.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part anchored to the floor and connected to the water and drainage systems.
